title: Avocado Egg Toast
description: Creamy avocado spread on toasted bread with perfectly cooked eggs and sautéed veggies
ingredients: red chili flakes, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat a little olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and bell pepper and sauté until softened; season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Crack the eggs over the veggies, add more seasoning, top with spinach, and cover. Steam until the eggs reach your preferred doneness.
Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with salt, pepper, and chili flakes, then spread onto the toast.
Place the cooked eggs and veggies on top. Add cheese if you like.

title: Sooji Besan Cheela
description: A quick savory pancake made with semolina and chickpea flour
ingredients: salt, turmeric, red chili powder, black pepper
instructions: Mix sooji, besan, and yogurt in a 1:1:0.5 ratio, adding water gradually to make a loose batter (sooji will thicken as it absorbs water).
Add chopped onion, coriander, green chili, and spices.
Rest the batter for 20 minutes.
Spread each scoop of batter on hot greased pan like a dosa, cook until golden brown on both sides.

title: Honey Lemon Chicken
description: Chicken drumsticks with honey lemon glaze
instructions: Marinate chicken drumstick with salt and pepper for like 10 mins. Also cut deep slits in each drumstick
After heating oil in a pan, cook drumsticks on all sides for 8 mins. Should get some browning
Combine honey, lemon juice, garlic, salt, & a splash of soy sauce. Pour into pan. Add bit of water as well
Cover pan and cook for 10 mins. Finish with some cilantro optionally. Serve with rice.

title: Chicken Lo Mein
description: A delicious stir-fried noodle dish with chicken and vegetables.
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, red chili flakes, tumeric, red chili powder
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink. Remove from pan.
In the same pan, add garlic, onion, carrots, and broccoli. Stir-fry for a few minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the pan. Add cooked noodles and soy sauce. Toss everything together until well combined.
Season with salt, black pepper, red chili flakes, turmeric, and red chili powder to taste.

title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: Creamy pasta tossed with chicken, garlic, parmesan, and fresh basil.
photoDescription: Creamy chicken Alfredo pasta garnished with basil and parmesan.
ingredients: Black pepper, salt, red chili flakes
instructions: Heat butter and olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add diced chicken and cook until chicken in no longer pink.
Add chopped onion and garlic and sauté for a couple minutes until onions are translucent.
Add the chopped tomato and cook briefly to bring out color.
Pour in the heavy whipping cream and stir gently until bubbly.
Lower the heat and mix in parmesan cheese
Season with salt, black pepper, and red chili flakes.
Add the cooked pasta and toss until fully coated.
Garnish with fresh basil and extra parmesan before serving.

title: Aloo Paratha
description: Stuffed flatbread filled with spiced potatoes and onions
instructions: In a mixing bowl, kneed together the chakki atta with warm water to form a soft, pliable, and smooth dough. Add water slowly.  Cover and let it rest for 20 minutes.
In another bowl, combine the mashed potatoes, chopped onion, green chilies, coriander, red chili powder, garam masala, cumin powder, turmeric, and salt. Mix well to create the filling.
Divide the dough into equal balls. Roll each ball slightly, place a spoonful of potato stuffing in the center, and fold the edges inward to seal.
Gently roll the stuffed dough ball into a flat paratha, dusting with flour as needed. Be carefuly not to having stuffing burst out
Heat a pan or tawa on medium heat. Place the paratha and cook until golden spots appear.
Flip and apply ghee or oil. Cook both sides until crisp and golden.
Serve hot with yogurt, pickle, or butter.

title: Bhindi Masala
description: Spicy okra curry with onions and Indian spices
instructions: Wash okra and pat dry. Cut off the tops and slice into pieces.
Heat oil in a pan. Add okra into pan. Stir minimally to avoid sliminess.
After bhindi is cooked 60-70%, add chopped onion, ginger, green chilies, turmeric, and coriander powder.
Cook until onions are translucent. Then add salt. Cook for another few minutes.

title: Roti
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine whole wheat flour with warm water and butter gradually to form a soft dough. Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and not sticky.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 20 minutes.
Divide the dough into equal portions and roll each portion into a ball.
On a floured surface, roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Heat a skillet or tawa over medium-high heat. Place the rolled-out dough on the skillet.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side until golden brown spots appear.
Optionally, apply butter on top of the cooked roti before serving.

title: Curd Rice
description: A refreshing and healthy rice dish with curd and spices
instructions: Heat the rice in the microwave or on the stove until warm.
In a bowl, mix the warm rice with yogurt. Add water if you prefer a creamier consistency.
Season with salt to taste. Serve with avakaya pickle or any savory side dish.

title: Lauki Kofta
description: A traditional Indian curry made with bottle gourd fried dumplings in a spiced tomato gravy
ingredients: Salt, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add onion, garlic, and green chili. Saute for 2-3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, cashews, and spices (turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder). Cook for a minute.
Add water, cover & cook. Then blend the mixture into a smooth gravy.
In a separate bowl, take grated lauki (squeeze out water), onion, green chili, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt, coriander leaves, and besan. Mix well.
Form little balls, and then deep fry them until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
In separate pan, heat some oil, then add the prepared gravy. Cook for 4-5 minutes. Add lauki water to adjust consistency. to adjust consistency.
Add back the fried kofta. On top add kasuri methi, coriander leaves, fresh cream. Serve

title: Tomato Bisque Soup
description: A creamy tomato soup perfect for a quick and easy meal
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, red chili flakes, basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place tomatoes, onion, and garlic on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast in the oven for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.
Transfer roasted vegetables to a blender. Add a splash of water or vegetable broth and blend until smooth.
Pour the blended mixture into a pot. Stir in heavy cream and grated parmesan cheese. Heat over medium heat until warmed through.
Season with additional salt, black pepper, red chili flakes, and fresh basil to taste.
Serve hot with crusty bread or croutons.

title: Tomato Egg Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious stir fry made with tomatoes and eggs
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Pour eggs and scramble until just set. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add scallions and tomatoes. Stir-fry scallions for a minute.
Once fragrant, add the tomatoes and a splash of water
Let that simmer for a few minutes. When the tomatoes become soft and release their juices, add soy sauce, sugar, ketchup, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Once thickened, incorporate the scrambled eggs. Finish with some sesame oil.
